overview: In the morning Golding's Ovid was open on the desk, and Gib lay across the page. You copied nothing. You did not read a line out loud to the room. The cat stayed where he was.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked at the covered page and copied nothing.

assets.name: Ovid
assets.disposition: Left the cat on the page

summary: Left the cat on the page
